## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::GovernanceTooManySigners` — the signer set exceeds MAX_SIGNERS.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::bootstrap_refuses_a_signer_set_that_is_not_two_distinct_keys`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::bootstrap_refuses_a_signer_set_that_is_not_two_distinct_keys). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// GovernanceTooManySigners — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let mut set = soroban_sdk::Vec::new(&f.env);
for _ in 0..crate::MAX_SIGNERS + 1 {
    set.push_back(Address::generate(&f.env));
}
Some(rejected!(f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_governance_bootstrap(
        &f.governor,
        &set,
        &crate::DEFAULT_VETO_WINDOW_SECONDS,
    )))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked bootstrap_refuses_a_signer_set_that_is_not_two_distinct_keys
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Reduce the signer set to at most `MAX_SIGNERS` distinct addresses before bootstrapping or rotating.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#2-governance-failure-modes-and-mitigations`](../../docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#2-governance-failure-modes-and-mitigations)
